column1: # Every gate in tests/test-lib.sh that reads repo source text, classified.
# Measured by reading all 278 of them, one at a time, in August 2026 — not
# sampled and not extrapolated. Two earlier samples disagreed (4 of 12, then
# 8 of 12), which is what a sample of this population does; the counts below
#   A   the gate's claim is a RUNTIME behaviour and its only evidence is that
#       the source still contains a token or a shape. It cannot tell "the code
#       does this" from "the code says this". This is the debt.
#   B   the subject genuinely IS text — documentation, a message, a config
#       value, agreement between two written artefacts, or an exhaustive
#       absence rule where the source itself is the thing under rule. A grep is
#       the correct and complete instrument here.
#   FP  not debt: the gate drives its subject and inspects the result. The
#       scanner flags it because driving needs a path to the script.
#   H   a helper, not a gate: it extracts source for a gate to judge. Its debt,
#       if any, belongs to the gate that calls it.
# Format: LABEL <TAB> function <TAB> what it actually does.
# The A rows are the debt and may only go down. Converting one means moving its
# row to FP, not deleting it.
